title: Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood
abstract: arXiv:2611.18642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little is known about how much of what an agent has learned survives being written down. We study this in 56 interactive worlds with hidden rules, where an agent that is told nothing fails and an agent given a 300-character statement of the rules succeeds. We compare one agent that plays eight lives and keeps its whole history with a chain of eight agents that each play one life and inherit a 300-character note. All six models we test learn less in the chain: after eight generations it stands where the single agent stood after about four lives. Controlled variants of the chain decompose this handoff loss into three components: none from changing the agent, a smaller loss from compressing to 300 characters, and a larger loss from compressing rep

translated_title: 智能体无法交出它们尚未理解的东西
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18642v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在单个上下文窗口之外工作、或在团队中协作的智能体，会以简短的书面总结形式将其工作移交给后继者。现有评估主要关注智能体能否解决任务，而对于智能体所学到的知识在写下来之后有多少得以保留，人们知之甚少。我们在56个带有隐藏规则的交互世界中对这一问题进行了研究：在这些世界中，未被告知任何信息的智能体会失败，而获得一条300字符规则陈述的智能体则会成功。我们比较了两种设置：一个智能体玩八次（八条命）并保留完整历史，与一条由八个智能体组成的链——其中每个智能体只玩一次，并继承一条300字符的笔记。我们测试的全部六个模型在链条中的学习效果都更差：经过八代之后，其水平仅相当于单个智能体玩约四次后达到的水平。通过对链条的受控变体实验，我们将这种交接损失分解为三个组成部分：更换智能体本身没有造成损失，压缩到300字符带来较小的损失，而压缩表征造成了更大的损失……
tldr: 该研究通过56个隐藏规则世界实验发现，多代智能体以简短笔记传递知识会产生显著的“交接损失”——八代智能体的学习效果仅相当于单个智能体连续工作约四次，且损失主要来自对所学表征的压缩而非智能体的更换。
en_tdlr: This study reveals through 56 hidden-rule worlds that multi-agent knowledge handoff via brief notes incurs significant "handoff loss"—a chain of eight agents learns only as much as a single agent does in about four lives—with the loss stemming mainly from compressing learned representations rather than changing agents.
